513-2459-3558.easyPrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana cost {0} must be in your hand with the other being on the battlefield.
513-2459-3558.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your hand by paying {0}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the other creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

1339-1832-4050-5933.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-5933.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

240-3480-4247-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1011-2728-2921-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-2921-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-2921-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-6822-7267.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Michelangelo
Repeat.

864-1741-2397-3378.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
864-1741-2397-3378.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Cloud of Faeries and causing you to draw a card.
When Eternal Witness and Cloud of Faeries enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger twice each.
Resolve the first Eternal Witness trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Eternal Witness trigger, returning any other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-4565-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Ozolith, the Shattered Spire and Primal Vigor.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

891-2921-7424.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

147-2438-5188.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-5188.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3490-6006-7075-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6006-7075-7296.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1295-2757-3832.easyPrerequisites: You control a basic Plains or Island.
1295-2757-3832.description:
Activate a basic Plains or Island by tapping it, adding {W/U}
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Puresight Merrow, untapping the basic Plains or Island.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck size is less than or equal to 2 plus your devotion to blue.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}. When it enters, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-3899-7175.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

57-969-4235-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-969-4235-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

147-3967-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

1974-4608-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Quicksilver Gargantuan.
1974-4608-5466.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
1974-4608-5466.description:
Cast Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Quicksilver Gargantuan into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Quicksilver Gargantuan's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Quicksilver Gargantuan's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Quicksilver Gargantuan's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

549-3259-5953-6633.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
549-3259-5953-6633.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-5953-6633.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2498-3591-6282.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one more card in hand than your maximum hand size.
2498-3591-6282.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Necropotence triggers for each card discarded.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Discard cards down until your maximum hand size, as the cleanup step is still onging.
Repeat from step 2.

224-277-1772-5233.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Boros Garrison
Holding priority, activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{W}.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

2073-2707-4872-6504.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
2073-2707-4872-6504.description:
If Conjurer's Bauble is in your graveyard, activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Time Warp onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

3101-3940-6259.manaNeeded: {R}{R}{R} minus {R} for each +1/+1 counter on Runaway Steam-Kin
3101-3940-6259.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has at least three +1/+1 counters on it, activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}.
Haze of Rage's storm ability and Runaway Steam-Kin trigger.
Resolve the Runaway Steam-Kin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rages.
Repeat.

2061-2103-2187.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
2061-2103-2187.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2781-3719-5912.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three experience counters
2781-3719-5912.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Felidar Guardian and create at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
2781-3719-5912.notes: If you have four or more experience counters, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

654-1669-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
654-1669-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Thaumatog's first ability by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

1052-2034-3175.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

738-3652-4733-5256.description:
Sacrifice Ornithopter to Altar of Dementia.
Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Ornithopter to your hand.
Resolve Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
